rongmei.title: Gaypui Ramc tei Tingkauh Hamhna cho?

lines: 48 Gaypui Ramc tei Tingkauh Hamhna Cho?
1. Gaypui ramc tei tingkauh hamhna cho? (3)
Ai tat ni.
Gaypui ramc tei tingkauh hamhna cho? (2)
Ai tat ni, ai tat ni heic ramc thangc.
2. Neihmik key dat makpui ramc khoutei (3)
Ai tat ni.
Neihmik key dat makpui ramc khoutei (2)
Ai tat ni, ai tat ni heic ramc thangc.
3. Khuaihdui luangce, guaih noudui luangc e (3)
Heic ramc tei.
Khuaihdui luangc e, guaih noudui luangc e (2)
Ai tat ni, ai tat ni heic ramc thangc.
4. Zinghmei nai dat makpui ramc khoutei (3)
Ai tat ni.
Zinghmei nai dat makpui ramc khoutei (2)
Ai tat ni, ai tat ni heic ramc thangc..
5. Ryanraa ryanriumei maekpui ramc thangc (3)
Ai tat ni.
Ryanraa ryanriumei maekpui ramc thangc (2)
Ai tat ni, ai tat ni heic ramc thangc.
6. Mwnpwang gaymei puanghpui ramc thangc tei (3)
Ai tat ni.
Mwnpwang gaymei puanghpui ramc thangc tei (2)
Ai tat ni, ai tat ni heic ramc thangc.
7. Hallelujah he Hellelujah (3)
Thuanc bam ni.
Hallelujah he Hallelujah (2)
Thuanc bam ni, Thuanc bam ni heic ramc thangc.
